title: Rappler Recap: Trump meets ASEAN leaders at special summit
summary: Rappler reporter Jelo Mantaring gives a rundown of the issues raised during the ASEAN-US Special Summit, attended by US President Donald Trump

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – United States President Donald Trump is the last international leader to arrive in the Philippines during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits, meeting ASEAN leaders after the closing ceremony on Tuesday, November 17.
In this recap, Rappler reporter Jelo Mantaring gives a rundown of the issues raised during the special summit. – Rappler.com
